terms.label: Applicant is a parent
terms.definition: The requester is the child's legal parent.

anchors.quote: A parent who has legal custody is the legal representative of a child. Parents who have joint legal custody have a joint right of representation.
anchors.note: The demo treats parent status as the normal gateway claim.

terms.label: Applicant is not a parent
terms.definition: The requester is a relative or third party rather than a parent.

anchors.quote: A parent who has legal custody is the legal representative of a child. Parents who have joint legal custody have a joint right of representation.
anchors.note: Used as the simple negative counterpart of parent status.

terms.label: Applicant has sole custody
terms.definition: The applicant may act alone because sole custody exists.

anchors.quote: A parent represents his or her child alone if: 1) he or she has sole legal custody of the child, or 2) the powers of decision have been transferred to him or her pursuant to § 119 of this Act.
anchors.note: One explicit basis for acting alone.

terms.label: Decision right has been delegated
terms.definition: Authority for this decision has been delegated to the applicant.

anchors.quote: A parent represents his or her child alone if: 1) he or she has sole legal custody of the child, or 2) the powers of decision have been transferred to him or her pursuant to § 119 of this Act.
anchors.note: The other explicit basis for acting alone.

terms.label: There is an emergency
terms.definition: Waiting would harm the child's interests.

anchors.quote: If making a joint declaration of intention of the parents would cause a delay in conflict with the interests of the child, one parent has the right to enter into necessary transactions and perform necessary acts in the interests of the child also alone.
anchors.note: Operationalized as the urgent case visible in the request text.

terms.label: Both parents consent
terms.definition: There is confirmed consent from both parents.

anchors.quote: Parents shall exercise joint legal custody with respect to their child and perform the custodial obligation on their own responsibility and unanimously considering all-round well-being of the child. Parents who have joint legal custody have a joint right of representation.
anchors.note: Cited as “§ 118 (1) and § 120 (1)”. Represents the joint-action baseline.

terms.label: One parent is unreachable
terms.definition: The other parent cannot currently be contacted.

anchors.quote: If making a joint declaration of intention of the parents would cause a delay in conflict with the interests of the child, one parent has the right to enter into necessary transactions and perform necessary acts in the interests of the child also alone.
anchors.note: Used as a simple observable sign that delay may be harmful.

terms.definition: The cadastre records the intended purpose (or one of the intended purposes) of the land as residential land.

anchors.quote: The land under the home is considered to be land owned by the land owner ... the intended purpose or one of the intended purposes of which is residential land ...
anchors.note: Residential land-use category for home-land exemption.

terms.label: Owner's primary residence is registered on the parcel
terms.definition: The population registry lists the applicant's primary residence on the parcel.

anchors.quote: ... in case the building on this land is the residence of the land owner or user according to the residence data entered in the population register.
anchors.note: Population-registry residence condition.

terms.label: Applicant owns the parcel
terms.definition: The land registry shows the applicant as the current owner.

anchors.quote: The land under the home is considered to be land owned by the land owner ...
anchors.note: Ownership precondition for home-land exemption.

terms.label: Applicant receives a state pension
terms.definition: The social-insurance registry records the applicant as a state-pension recipient.

anchors.quote: ... an additional tax incentive of up to 1,000 euros to the following target groups: 1) pension recipients based on the State Pension Insurance Act;
anchors.note: Pensioner target group for the supplementary exemption.

terms.label: Municipality has set the exemption
terms.definition: The land-tax information system records a § 11(1)/(5) exemption set by the local council.

anchors.quote: The municipal council may establish by a regulation ... a tax incentive ... on the land under the home ...
anchors.note: Local-council act is required to activate the exemption.

terms.label: Supplementary-exemption application has been submitted
terms.definition: Applicant confirms that the § 11(7) application has been submitted in the required form.

anchors.quote: To receive additional tax incentive specified in subsection 5 or 6 of this section, a person who meets the conditions provided in this section submits an application to the municipality in accordance with the procedure established by the council.
anchors.note: User-provided confirmation of submitted application.
